standard-dialogue.npc: What can I do for you, [m'lady/sir]?

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.npc: It's my job to keep track of operations on the docks.

options.text: Is there anything I can help out with?

steps.player: Is there anything I can help out with?

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 30 Crafting:

steps.npc: Thanks for the offer, but I'm afraid you need a higher crafting level before you can help me.

steps.text: You need a crafting level of 30 to assist the Piscarilius dockmaster.
If the player has at least 30 Crafting:

steps.npc: You look like you know a thing or two about crafting, perhaps you could help us maintain the fishing cranes around the docks.
You'll need a hammer, some nails and a few wooden planks, 3 planks per broken crane should be enough.
I can't offer you any payment at the moment, but hard work doesn't go unnoticed around these parts.

steps.player: Sure, I'll see what I can do.

options.text: I'll let you get back to work.

steps.player: I'll let you get back to work.

options.text: Sorry, I was just looking around.

steps.player: Sorry, I was just looking around.

treasure-trails-medium.npc: I have a question for you.

treasure-trails-medium.text: The Dockmaster has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-medium-when-talked-to-ag.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.text: The Dockmaster has given you another clue scroll!
